# SimEngine

A modular framework for statistical simulations in R

## Overview

**SimEngine** is an open-source R package for structuring, maintaining,
running, and debugging statistical simulations on both local and
cluster-based computing environments.

## Installation

The latest stable version of **SimEngine** can be installed from CRAN
using
[`install.packages()`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html):

``` r
install.packages("SimEngine")
```

The current development version can be installed using
`devtools::install_github()`:

``` r
devtools::install_github(repo="Avi-Kenny/SimEngine")
```

## Documentation

The full package documentation can be found at
<https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/>.

## Bugs reports and feature requests

To submit a bug report or request a new feature, please submit a new
[GitHub Issue](https://github.com/Avi-Kenny/SimEngine/issues).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`batch()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/batch.md)
  : Run a block of code as part of a batch
- [`get_complex()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/get_complex.md)
  : Access internal simulation variables
- [`js_support()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/js_support.md)
  : Display information about currently-supported job schedulers
- [`new_sim()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/new_sim.md)
  : Create a new simulation object
- [`run()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/run.md) :
  Run the simulation
- [`run_on_cluster()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/run_on_cluster.md)
  : Framework for running simulations on a cluster computing system
- [`set_config()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/set_config.md)
  : Modify the simulation configuration
- [`set_levels()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/set_levels.md)
  : Set simulation levels
- [`set_script()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/set_script.md)
  : Set the "simulation script"
- [`summarize()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/summarize.md)
  : Summarize simulation results
- [`update_sim()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/update_sim.md)
  : Update a simulation
- [`update_sim_on_cluster()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/update_sim_on_cluster.md)
  : Framework for updating simulations on a cluster computing system
- [`use_method()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/use_method.md)
  : Use a method
- [`vars()`](https://avi-kenny.github.io/SimEngine/reference/vars.md) :
  Access internal simulation variables
